The four-armed '''Nabrun Leids''' was a [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]-for-hire, flying the [[Scarlet Vertha/Legends|''Scarlet Vertha'']]. He liked to brag that he could take anyone anywhere for the right price.

==Biography==
[[File:NabrunLeids-JK.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Leids in Chalmun's cantina]]
Nabrun once worked for [[Omogg]], a [[Drackmarian]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] of [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]], as did many others of his species. He later left that region of space to escape [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] after he broke the contract. He was particularly familiar with the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], between the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Leids was present in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] along with the smuggler [[Rycar Ryjerd/Legends|Rycar Ryjerd]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] came to look for a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], eventually meeting [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

==Behind the scenes==
Nabrun Leids first appeared as a cantina alien in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], but the character's true first appearance was in the second issue of [[Marvel Comics]]' adaptation of the film, published fifteen days prior to the film's release.<ref name="tcr">[[Wikipedia:The Comic Reader|''The Comic Reader'']] #143, provided by Marvel</ref> During the film's production, Leids' species was listed as "Plutonian" by [[John Mollo]].<ref name="Art Of Star Wars">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope]]''</ref> According to [[Tom Spina]], in the film, Leids was portrayed by an actress named [[Diana Sadley Way]], who was also listed in Mollo's notes.<ref name="Tom Spina Leids E-Mail">{{EmailCite|email=File:DianSadleyWayPProof.png|creator=Tom Spina|date=2021-06-12}}</ref><ref name="Art Of Star Wars" /> Leids was first identified and given a brief backstory in the [[December]] [[1995]] ''[[Premiere Limited]]'' base set of the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''. Nabrun Leids also received an entry in the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game|''Jedi Knight Trading Card Game'']] [[Premiere (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Premiere'']] base set released on [[April 25]], [[2001]] and later the first expansions set of the card game, [[Scum and Villainy (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Scum And Villainy'']] published on [[July 11]], [[2001]].
